title: Netflix Advertising for Small Businesses: What You Need to Know

facts.fact: Netflix's direct advertising sales typically require minimum campaign spends of $10,000 or more.
facts.quote: Netflix's direct advertising sales operation requires working with agency partners and typically involves minimum spends of $10,000 or more.

facts.fact: Netflix's direct ad sales typically require minimum campaign spends of $10,000 to $25,000 or more.
facts.quote: Minimum campaign spends of $10,000 to $25,000+

facts.fact: Netflix direct advertising CPMs (cost per thousand impressions) range from $40 to $60.
facts.quote: CPMs (cost per thousand impressions) ranging from $40 to $60

facts.fact: Through Adwave's programmatic platform, the low minimum spend for Netflix access starts at $30 a day.
facts.quote: Low minimum spend (start at $30 a day with Adwave)

facts.fact: Programmatic access to Netflix inventory has CPMs that can range from $35 to $50, depending on targeting.
facts.quote: CPMs that can range from $35 to $50, depending on targeting

facts.fact: With Adwave, campaigns can start at $50.
facts.quote: With Adwave, you can start campaigns at just $50

facts.fact: Netflix's ad-supported tier launched in late 2022.
facts.quote: Netflix's ad-supported tier launched in late 2022 and has grown faster than most analysts predicted.

facts.fact: As of 2024, Netflix reports over 40 million global users on its ad-supported plans.
facts.quote: As of 2024, the platform reports over 40 million global users on ad-supported plans

facts.fact: The Netflix ad-supported plan is priced at $6.99 per month, compared with $15.49 for the Standard plan.
facts.quote: Price-conscious consumers attracted by the lower monthly fee ($6.99 vs $15.49 for Standard)

facts.fact: The Netflix standard plan without ads is priced at $15.49 per month.
facts.quote: ($6.99 vs $15.49 for Standard)

facts.fact: Netflix's ad load is approximately 4-5 minutes of ads per hour.
facts.quote: approximately 4-5 minutes of ads per hour

facts.fact: AVOD platforms such as Tubi, Pluto TV, and Freevee have CPMs of $15-25.
facts.quote: Lower CPMs ($15-25)

facts.fact: Tubi alone has 80M+ monthly users, according to the page.
facts.quote: Massive reach (Tubi alone has 80M+ monthly users)

facts.fact: The page suggests, for a $1,000 monthly budget, allocating 70% to AVOD platforms and 30% to Netflix.
facts.quote: A smart strategy for a $1,000 monthly budget might be: 70% on AVOD platforms for reach, 30% on Netflix for prestige and higher-income audience exposure.

facts.fact: The page states that AVOD platforms can reach three to four times as many viewers for the same spend compared to Netflix.
facts.quote: You can reach three to four times as many viewers for the same spend compared to Netflix.

facts.fact: Per the page, a $200-400/month Netflix test budget at a $40 programmatic CPM delivers approximately 5,000-10,000 impressions across Netflix and other streaming platforms.
facts.quote: At programmatic CPMs of $40, this delivers approximately 5,000-10,000 impressions across Netflix and other streaming platforms.

facts.fact: Per the page, a $500-1,000/month budget delivers approximately 12,500-25,000 impressions, reaching an estimated 4,200-8,300 unique households in a local market.
facts.quote: Approximately 12,500-25,000 impressions reaching an estimated 4,200-8,300 unique households.

facts.fact: Per the page, a $1,500-3,000/month budget delivers approximately 37,500-75,000 impressions, reaching an estimated 12,500-25,000 unique households.
facts.quote: Approximately 37,500-75,000 impressions reaching an estimated 12,500-25,000 unique households.

facts.fact: The page's example split allocates $1,000 to AVOD platforms at a $20 CPM, which it says yields approximately 50,000 impressions.
facts.quote: $1,000 on AVOD platforms at $20 CPM (approximately 50,000 impressions for reach)

facts.fact: The page states that Netflix's ad-supported tier is priced at $6.99/month, compared with $15.49/month for the Standard plan.
facts.quote: At $6.99/month (compared to $15.49 for Standard)

facts.fact: The page states that over 40 million global Netflix subscribers have chosen the ad-supported tier.
facts.quote: over 40 million global subscribers (and counting) have chosen the lower-cost, ad-supported option.

facts.fact: The page says Netflix launched its ad-supported tier in late 2022.
facts.quote: When Netflix launched its ad-supported tier in late 2022

facts.fact: The page states that direct Netflix advertising typically requires minimum spends of $10,000 or more with CPMs of $40-60.
facts.quote: Direct Netflix advertising typically requires $10,000+ minimum spends with CPMs of $40-60.

facts.fact: The page states that Adwave's programmatic access to Netflix inventory starts at $50 with CPMs of $35-50.
facts.quote: small businesses can access Netflix inventory through programmatic platforms like Adwave starting at just $50, with CPMs ranging from $35-50.

facts.fact: The page states that Netflix CPMs are two to three times higher than free ad-supported platforms such as Tubi or Pluto TV.
facts.quote: the CPMs are two to three times higher than free ad-supported platforms like Tubi or Pluto TV.

facts.fact: The page says Netflix primarily runs 15-second and 30-second ad spots.
facts.quote: Netflix runs primarily 15-second and 30-second spots.

facts.fact: The page states that Netflix ads should be high-definition, with a 1080p minimum and 4K preferred.
facts.quote: Ads should be high-definition (1080p minimum, 4K preferred)

facts.fact: The page says programmatic platforms allow targeting Netflix viewers by metro area, state, or zip code radius.
facts.quote: You can target by metro area, state, or zip code radius

facts.fact: The page states that Netflix has no skip button on most ad formats.
facts.quote: Netflix has no skip button on most ad formats, resulting in higher completion rates.

facts.fact: According to the page, Netflix's direct ad sales remain out of reach for most local advertisers.
facts.quote: While the platform's direct sales remain out of reach for most local advertisers, programmatic access through platforms like Adwave opens the door

facts.fact: According to the page, small-budget advertisers should not expect exclusive Netflix placements and will instead reach Netflix viewers as part of a diversified streaming TV campaign.
facts.quote: You won't get exclusive Netflix placements with a small budget, but you will reach Netflix viewers as part of a diversified streaming TV campaign.

facts.fact: According to the page, Adwave provides programmatic access to Netflix advertising inventory alongside other premium streaming services.
facts.quote: programmatic access through platforms like Adwave opens the door to reaching Netflix's engaged, entertainment-focused audience alongside other premium streaming services.
